tools.name: maintainly_get_me
tools.description: Return the signed-in user and every profile this token reaches, with each organisation's route key. Use it to find the organisation key.

tools.name: maintainly_list_tasks
tools.description: List maintenance tasks in the organisation, newest first. Filter with GitHub-style terms, such as status:open, type:reactive or due:<2026-12-31.

tools.name: maintainly_get_task
tools.description: Return one task in full: assignees, work logs, materials, downtimes, checklists and its work request.

tools.name: maintainly_list_task_assignment
tools.description: List the users assigned to a task and the users not assigned. Use the user guids here with maintainly_assign_task.

tools.name: maintainly_list_work_requests
tools.description: List work requests (problems reported for an asset or location), with their status and the task raised from each. Filter with GitHub-style terms.

tools.name: maintainly_get_work_request
tools.description: Return one work request with its description, reporter details, files and linked task.

tools.name: maintainly_assign_task
tools.description: Set the assignees of a task to exactly these users. Send every user who should stay assigned, because the request sets the full list. Get guids from maintainly_list_task_assignment.

tools.name: maintainly_add_task_comment
tools.description: Post a comment on a task. The comment is visible to everyone who can see the task.

tools.name: maintainly_create_work_request
tools.description: Create a work request that reports a problem. It starts as open and can become a task after review.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: maintainly_create_work_request · Private data: maintainly_get_me, maintainly_get_work_request · Public sink: maintainly_assign_task, maintainly_add_task_comment.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: maintainly_create_work_request · Private data: maintainly_get_me, maintainly_get_work_request · Public sink: maintainly_assign_task, maintainly_add_task_comment

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
